reviews.text: Lovely vet
Very good. Very welcoming!
The vet seemed quite attentive, everything went well. I think we've found our vet close to home, it's really very convenient 🐾🐕 …
Fantastic vets, attentive and very gentle with our animals!
A loyal customer for 15 years for my cat and dog, I am very satisfied with this clinic: the welcome, competence, professionalism, and friendly service. I highly recommend it.
Very friendly and attentive
Gentle and effective.

Excellent service at the clinic, the vet was lovely with my little Pomeranian puppy who didn't really want her eyes touched. Effective treatment. Nothing to add except go there to take good care of your animals!
Perfect and very professional
A huge thank you to Hugo and Clemence! They're always available and extremely kind; it's very reassuring to have professionals nearby to take care of our dog at the slightest problem.

I took my cat there this week, and I felt completely confident and listened to.

I highly recommend it!
Absolutely fantastic, and it even handles big dogs!
They are really good at heir jobs and always welcome you with a smile. My dog is really comfortable with them, also they can speak in English which is huge for us since we are not fluent in French.
The vet reassured the animal, listened attentively, and answered all our questions… I recommend her 100%, she's the best!
Very friendly welcome and competent care.

For so many years!
Trustworthy and helpful, always attentive and available. Thank you, Anne.
Great! Appointment on time, impeccable service, excellent consultation with answers and explanations. Very good rapport with both the animal and the human 👍 …

The team was very friendly, and the doctors helped me obtain a pet health certificate. Thanks to them, my puppy and I were able to return to Mexico without any problems. I loved how patiently they were in explaining the French process to me. We will definitely contact them again 100% when we return to Paris!!!

Thank you to the veterinary team for their patience with our dog, who usually reacts badly to the vet. Each step was adapted to him, and everything was well explained to us. We found his specialists! And the welcome has always been great since we started coming (2021), so thank you very much!
The staff are competent, knowledgeable, and skilled; my cat is well cared for, and I highly recommend this clinic. The animals leave happy.
A charming, attentive, and understanding team. No complaints whatsoever.
Nothing to say. Excellent clinic
Very good across the board !

Hello
I am very happy with this veterinary clinic. My cat Ivan, who suffers from chronic bronchitis, is very well cared for. I saw other vets before, and my cat was on loads of medication. At this clinic, just one medication (a small pill) and everything is fine. My cat is in excellent health at almost 12 years old, and coughs much, much less and for much shorter periods.
A big thank you to the whole team; they are very kind, professional, and attentive.

A wonderful discovery! We came in as an emergency for my little Chihuahua who had an eye ulcer. I got an appointment that morning and a follow-up four days later.
We arrived on a sweltering day, and a bowl of cool water was waiting for Rosie. To finish off the treatment and consultation, she received a little treat.
Both veterinarians are very gentle and reassuring. The two receptionists are very pleasant. It's a small practice near Montparnasse, and most importantly, the bill isn't exorbitant.
I highly recommend them and will definitely return for future visits.

Thank you!

The Alizée clinic opened at the foot of my building 11 years ago, right when I was given a 2-month-old kitten (I'd never had a cat before!). So I knew absolutely nothing! I've always received excellent service and advice 👏 The team is fantastic, especially Anne, who has been there from the start and is always available 🦋 The various veterinarians I've seen are very professional and friendly; I thank them all warmly, Marie Laure
Friendly vets and staff and great with afeisty cat
Our cats have been treated at Alizé Vet for 7 years and we are very satisfied with the welcome and the care provided.
Excellent clinic. The veterinarians are attentive, clear, and offer good advice. They have been treating my animals for years.
Keep up the good work taking care of our animals. Good luck and have a good day everyone.
The staff are attentive, helpful, and caring; it's always a pleasure to come to the clinic.
I highly recommend it!

I have two cats who have been treated at the Alizée Vet clinic for 3 years. The reception is very friendly, and the advice from the veterinarians, including on nutrition, keeps my cats in excellent health.
A top-notch veterinary team, always available, attentive and dedicated to providing the best possible care for our animals.
Friendly welcome, attentive and available. Accurate diagnoses.
I recommend this clinic; the reception is good and they are always attentive.

The vet was fine, but the receptionist... hmmm, I've never seen such behavior. When I had the misfortune of telling her that my dog ​​was spayed elsewhere, her face completely changed! And yes, ma'am, I do what I want, it's just unbelievable! One day my dog ​​ate some plastic, and she told me to keep an eye on her and that if she wasn't okay, I should consult a vet. Okay, fine. Well, it finally passed. A month later, I went to buy some medicine for my dog, and she told me I needed to consult a vet about what she ate a month ago, not to mention the time she actually hung up on me. I could tell the receptionist wasn't happy. On the other hand, when you open your wallet, with a huge smile from ear to ear, she won't sell me the flea medication because I don't consult a vet! 😂😂😂 But to consult a vet, maybe my dog ​​would have to be sick. Anyway, my vet is a bit more polite, but at least I'm well received, with or without a wallet! I won't go back. A smiling receptionist only when you take out money! It's very unpleasant, and she insists by any means necessary! It's a shame because the vet is very good, but the receptionists are too pushy in trying to get you to pay and make it very clear they don't like it! And yes, you can see their intentions like that, and it's not very inviting. Luckily, it's not like that everywhere! I won't be going back there, and certainly not for a consultation to be treated like that. No thank you.
